scope: Continuation audit of the committed autonomous optimization; existing project boundaries preserved.

corrections.issue: Descendants inheriting stdout/stderr delay close after parent exit.
corrections.change: Clean the detached process group on parent exit, retaining the close fallback.
corrections.regression: Fake descendant holding the parent's stdout pipe no longer survives until its natural exit; parent usage and completed status remain intact.

corrections.issue: Already-cancelled calls still prepared a workspace and attempted process dispatch.
corrections.change: Check cancellation before preparation and after asynchronous preparation, before dispatch.
corrections.regression: Pre-aborted fixture data is not read; cancellation during preparation returns without a CLI dispatch and unknown usage stays null.

corrections.issue: Empty, misspelled and mixed modes could report clean without scanning.
corrections.change: Accept one exact mode or an explicit file list; invalid usage exits 2; -- protects option-like filenames.
corrections.regression: Invalid CLI arguments fail and an option-like filename containing a synthetic pattern is detected.

corrections.issue: Retention used History IDs captured before acquiring the assessment lock and could delete another tab's newer assessment.
corrections.change: Read current History inside the write callback; reject removed targets or unreadable History.
corrections.regression: Synthetic two-tab lock queue preserves newly added assessments, removed targets, unreadable history and unsaved drafts, alongside existing conflict checks.

corrections.issue: Repository overview incorrectly claimed no live provider adapter existed anywhere.
corrections.change: Distinguish the pure exported package from the optional loopback demo and document strict scanner arguments.
